data.name: King Salmon Visitor Center
data.description: Located next door to the King Salmon Airport, the King Salmon Visitor Center provides information on the many federal public lands of Southwest Alaska, particularly those in the Bristol Bay area. A large collection of films is available for viewing and an Alaska Geographic bookstore sells maps, charts, videos, posters, clothing and more.

data.directionsInfo: This visitor center is located next to the passenger terminal at the King Salmon Airport.

operatingHours.description: The King Salmon Visitor Center is open weekdays during the summer season from 9am - 6pm. The VC is closed during the winter and will open in Mid May.

data.name: Brooks Camp Visitor Center
data.description: The Brooks Camp Visitor Center, open June 1 – September 29, is the point of entry for all visitors to Brooks Camp. A park ranger is on duty to provide information, campground check-in, mandatory bear etiquette and safety talks, and backcountry planning. An Alaska Geographic Association (AGA) bookstore offers books, maps, and other Katmai-related items.

data.directionsInfo: Brooks Camp is located on the northern Alaska Peninsula, about 30 miles east of King Salmon and about 290 air miles southwest of Anchorage. Unlike most national park visitor centers in the United States, Brooks Camp's visitor center is only accessible by plane or boat.

operatingHours.description: The Brooks Camp Visitor Center, open June 1– late September, is the point of entry for all visitors to Brooks Camp. A park ranger is on duty to provide information, campground check-in, mandatory bear etiquette and safety talks, and backcountry planning. An Alaska Geographic Association (AGA) bookstore offers books, maps, and other Katmai-related items.
operatingHours.name: Brooks Camp Visitor Center

data.name: Robert F. Griggs Visitor Center
data.description: The Robert F. Griggs Visitor Center overlooks the famous Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes and is the starting point of the Ukak Falls Trail. The posted hours are estimated because the visitor center is only open during ranger-led Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes tours.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: In blue ink and in a circle: Katmai National Park & Preserve Date of visit Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes

passportStampImages.altText: blue text in circle: Katmai National Park & Preserve, Virtual Visit, Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes

data.directionsInfo: Located 23 miles from Brooks Camp on the only road within Katmai National Park & Preserve. Visitors can participate in a Ranger-led Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes Tour where this center is a lunch stop before hiking to the valley floor.

operatingHours.description: These hours are estimated because the visitor center is only open during ranger-led Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes tours.
